reconstruction.scope: Specific Nelson Mandela Bay Stadium: mapped scalloped rounded rectangular flower roof/open central field, curved closed opaque metal petals and alternating closed pale membrane fields/renderable underside/three-chord truss approximations, two-level open colonnade/pale concrete galleries/dark glazed box band/closed recessed services and entries, broad red/warm lower seating tier/two narrower upper bands/aisles/hospitality belts, bounded supported sunken football floor/markings/goals and roof-hung neutral end displays/lights. Five existing shared concrete/paint/standing-seam/window-grid/canvas graphs. No generic smooth roof, field roof, whole lakeside/plaza slab, copied branding/crowd or furnished service interiors.

reconstruction.heightBasis: No qualified mapped architectural heights. Field working6m below anchor grade; roof17..40m above field, upper seating30m, glazed outer box16..20.5m, colonnade floors8/15.6m and36 near petals are ordinary-picture/native-plan visualization allocations, not measured structural dimensions or real excavation depths. Exact petal count/folding/corrugation, structural chords, seat/aisle/portal/step inventory and20degree/2m facing are approximate. Glazing/membrane/turf use quiet existing materials; membrane is represented by opaque double-skinned geometry, not optical transmission. Appearance follows2009-era gmp pictures; later changes/current equipment/condition are unverified. No access/engineering certification or concealed furnished interior claim.
reconstruction.terrainBasis: Original standard6m Mapzen ground/native roads/lake and unrelated building inputs remain unchanged. Anchor sample defines modelY0; field workingY-6 is a picture-led relative allocation, not a surveyed excavation. Occupied retaining floor/perimeter and each local column contact use retained samples. Bounded opening inside90percent mapped body/common supported floor reveals the sunken bowl without modifying source samples/outside terrain/water. Only both same-stadium parents are replaced; no whole plaza platform/flattening or water cutout. Failure/unload restore original ground/context.
